nodes.label: Everside-app README
nodes.community_name: App Shell, Dependencies and Staff Console

nodes.label: SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS (src/App.jsx)
nodes.rationale: Plan numbers typed by hand, not read from the database; must be kept in step with plan_limits.

nodes.label: SCOPE_GUARD
nodes.rationale: Instruction to the model plus a server side reply check; not a mathematical guarantee, hence strike limit and allowances as backstops.

nodes.label: 00_check_current_state.sql
nodes.rationale: Read only check of current state, including which tables cascade delete on user deletion.

nodes.label: everside-console.jsx staff console prototype
nodes.rationale: Calls the Navigator without signing in so it is now refused; do not deploy.

nodes.label: 02_lock_down_profiles_part2.sql
nodes.rationale: Only run once the new app works, because it revokes select * on profiles and the old app would fail to load profiles.

nodes.label: 01_security_fixes_part1.sql
nodes.rationale: Idempotent; safe before the new app is live. Creates feedback table, billing columns, Stripe webhook table, plan_limits, ai_usage and counting functions; stops if core tables such as children are missing.

nodes.label: AI cost model (Sonnet 5 token pricing)
nodes.rationale: $2/M input, $10/M output, $0.20/M cached input from a third party tracker; typical question about $0.013, 50 page PDF about $0.31. Prices must be checked in the Anthropic Console.

nodes.label: Document and photo reads allowance
nodes.rationale: A file is sent to the AI only with the message it belongs to and not resent on later turns, so one document does not cost again every turn. Vault filing uses a read but not a question.

nodes.label: Free help alternatives (IPSEA, SENDIASS)
nodes.rationale: Competitor and willingness-to-pay not researched; free help exists and private advocates charge hourly, so survey the waitlist before fixing price.

nodes.label: Free taster plan
nodes.rationale: Lifetime allowance: 10 questions, 5 per day, 1 document read, 5 page PDF, 4 MB file. Costs about 12p to 33p one off.

nodes.label: Full Support plan
nodes.rationale: Monthly reset: 250 questions, 40 per day, 50 document reads, 50 page PDF. £149 not safe against a maximum use customer; £199 or more with a 30 page PDF cap is suggested.

nodes.label: Guided plan
nodes.rationale: Monthly reset: 120 questions, 25 per day, 20 document reads, 25 page PDF, 5 MB. Proposed £99/year leaves about £76 for a heavy user and £41 worst case, so it cannot go negative on AI cost alone.

nodes.label: £3,000 a month income target
nodes.rationale: The income target, not AI cost, decides price: about 400 to 480 families at £99, 300 to 350 at £129.

nodes.label: plan_limits table
nodes.rationale: Supabase table holding allowances per tier; edits are live immediately with no deploy.

nodes.label: In-app usage meter
nodes.rationale: Read from the database so it is always right even if hand-typed plan blurbs lag; turns amber when low.

nodes.label: Throwaway test account with paid plan and access token
nodes.norm_label: throwaway test account with paid plan and access token
nodes.rationale: Paid plan needed because the free taster has only 10 messages and the script sends 19; token lasts about an hour and must not be shared.

nodes.label: Chat function hardening checks
nodes.rationale: 401 without token; 400 on bad role/file type/oversized message; client model and token limits ignored; history trimmed to 20; only newest message keeps its file; magic byte check; 429 per limit; OFF_TOPIC reply swapped for polite refusal with allowance refunded.

nodes.label: Known gaps after this update
nodes.rationale: Legal review of terms/privacy, refund policy undecided, hand-typed plan numbers, passcode storage, privacy policy placeholders (legal entity, email, ICO number).

nodes.label: 4 digit passcode screen lock
nodes.rationale: Locks for 15 minutes after 5 wrong attempts; still briefly stored in the browser before email link click and still only a screen lock (known gap).

nodes.label: Vault (document store with suggested folder and title)
nodes.norm_label: vault (document store with suggested folder and title)

nodes.label: Plans, allowances and what they cost
nodes.norm_label: plans, allowances and what they cost
nodes.rationale: Proposal for the owner to decide pricing; nothing published as a final price, pricing page says 'Price confirmed at launch'.

nodes.label: Topic guard test (scope-test)
nodes.rationale: Checks deployed /api/chat answers SEND/EHCP questions, refuses everything else including off topic photos and PDFs, and never refuses safety messages. About 19 requests, 25 to 40 US cents, 9 off topic strikes, so run once a day per test account.

nodes.label: Off topic sample PDF: Garden Landscaping invoice 1042
nodes.norm_label: off topic sample pdf: garden landscaping invoice 1042

nodes.label: On topic sample PDF: EHCP Section F extract
nodes.norm_label: on topic sample pdf: ehcp section f extract
nodes.rationale: Special educational provision: weekly 1:1 speech and language therapy, annual review due in March.

nodes.label: Everside security update: run order
nodes.rationale: About 60 minutes; do staging first, otherwise take a backup before changing production.

nodes.label: Anthropic monthly spend limit
nodes.rationale: Safety net: cap = (paying users x $2.30 + new free signups x $0.35) x 1.5; $50/month at launch. Hitting the cap stops the Navigator for everyone; allowances are refunded on provider failure.

nodes.label: Off topic refusal and strike limit
nodes.norm_label: off topic refusal and strike limit
nodes.rationale: Non SEND/EHCP questions are refused politely, the allowance is given back and a strike counts; ten strikes a day pauses chat. Safety messages are never refused.

nodes.label: Paid status rule (active or trialing only)
nodes.norm_label: paid status rule (active or trialing only)
nodes.rationale: Anything other than an active or trialing subscription with a known plan is treated as free taster, so cancelled or failed payments cannot keep paid allowances.

nodes.label: Safety messages never refused (WARN check)
nodes.rationale: WARN on a safety case means the model answered but did not mention an obvious source of help.

nodes.label: Anthropic spend limit (step 0)
nodes.rationale: Single most useful protection until the new chat function is live.

nodes.label: Off topic guard
nodes.rationale: An instruction to the model checked on the server; reliable for clear cases but not a guarantee, so daily strike limit and monthly allowances are the backstop.

nodes.label: Profiles lockdown (explicit columns, no self-set subscription)
nodes.norm_label: profiles lockdown (explicit columns, no self-set subscription)
nodes.rationale: Before: a user could set their own subscription active and anon could query the webhook table. After: permission denied, passcode hash unreadable, users cannot touch another user's children or vault.

nodes.label: tierForPriceId
nodes.rationale: Supports one Stripe price per tier; selling monthly and annual needs a second price id per tier here and in the checkout function.

nodes.label: Annual billing
nodes.rationale: Allowances still reset monthly so an annual subscriber cannot use twelve months in month one; upfront cash should be kept as a reserve for refunds and later AI cost.

nodes.label: Stripe UK fees
nodes.rationale: 1.5% plus 20p UK cards plus 0.7% Stripe Billing; annual billing means one fee a year, cheaper per customer.

nodes.label: Cloudflare variables and secrets
nodes.rationale: Includes SUPABASE_*, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, STRIPE_* keys, four STRIPE_PRICE_*_MONTHLY/ANNUAL ids replacing the old two, STRIPE_PORTAL_CONFIGURATION, CRON_SECRET, APP_URL, RESEND_API_KEY, MAIL_FROM.

nodes.label: Four Stripe prices (monthly and annual per plan)
nodes.norm_label: four stripe prices (monthly and annual per plan)
nodes.rationale: Each price is charged for the right plan and period and the browser cannot choose its own.

nodes.label: Chocolate Cake Recipe (off-topic scope test sample)
nodes.norm_label: chocolate cake recipe (off-topic scope test sample)

nodes.label: Everside Brand Palette (Deep Green on Cream)
nodes.norm_label: everside brand palette (deep green on cream)

nodes.label: Deep Green on Cream Brand Palette
nodes.norm_label: deep green on cream brand palette

nodes.label: Content Security Policy (Report Only first)
nodes.rationale: Watch console reports for a week before enforcing.

nodes.label: Everside E Monogram App Icon (dark green E on cream, 192px PWA icon)
nodes.norm_label: everside e monogram app icon (dark green e on cream, 192px pwa icon)

nodes.label: Supabase auth dashboard settings
nodes.rationale: Real redirect URLs only (no wildcards or localhost), custom SMTP, OTP expiry 3600s or less, Security Advisors, MFA on all provider accounts.

nodes.label: Fixed monthly running costs
nodes.rationale: About £25/month (£300/year) before AI: Supabase Pro, Resend, Cloudflare Pages, domain, ICO fee, Mailchimp. Legal review budget needed before taking payment.

nodes.label: ICO data protection fee
nodes.rationale: Register because the app handles children's data.

nodes.label: In-app cancel flow (feedback, keep or zip and delete)
nodes.norm_label: in-app cancel flow (feedback, keep or zip and delete)
nodes.rationale: Keep ends the plan at period end; zip and delete exports documents by child and folder then deletes; billing stops first and a Stripe failure deletes nothing; delete locked until the zip is made and acknowledged.

nodes.label: cancellation_feedback table
nodes.rationale: Private; parents cannot read or write it; feedback is unlinked from a deleted user.

nodes.label: 30 day and 7 day deletion warning emails
nodes.norm_label: 30 day and 7 day deletion warning emails

nodes.label: Daily clean up endpoint /api/purge-expired
nodes.rationale: Deletes lapsed accounts past their date and unused no-plan accounts after 6 months; never touches paying, trialing or past due accounts; sends each warning once and retries when email is not configured.

nodes.label: Stripe webhook endpoint /api/stripe-webhook
nodes.rationale: Receives checkout.session.completed and customer.subscription created/updated/deleted; records plan and period, starts the 6 month clock when a plan ends and clears it on renewal.

nodes.label: Stripe customer portal configuration (cancellation off)
nodes.rationale: Cancellation switched off in the portal so the in-app cancel flow is the only way to cancel and the feedback question and data choice cannot be skipped.

nodes.label: 6 month data deletion policy
nodes.rationale: profiles.data_delete_after set about 6 months after a plan ends; free accounts unused for 6 months also deleted with warnings.
